testimonials.quote: We shut the company in March and the analytics product was the part I could not bear to archive. The review desk asked for the repository history and our Stripe export before anything else. That was the moment I trusted the process.
testimonials.name: Ananya R.

testimonials.quote: I bought a support portal for a client instead of building one. The condition ledger listed two broken integrations up front, so the price made sense and nothing surprised us in week one.
testimonials.name: Karthik M.

testimonials.quote: The domain had been parked for three years. Listing it took one evening, and the desk sent back a single question about the registrar lock before it went live.
testimonials.name: Meera S.

testimonials.quote: Licensing the design system per year suited us better than buying it. The record said exactly which components were in scope and which fonts we had to license ourselves.
testimonials.name: Rohan D.

testimonials.quote: Nobody saw my contact details until an enquiry was accepted. For a solo founder that matters more than any feature.
testimonials.name: Farah K.

testimonials.quote: We compared three admin codebases on the index by condition, not by screenshots. The one we rented had the shortest dependency list, and the handover took nine days.
testimonials.name: Vikram P.

relay.title: Tokens were clean on day one
relay.body: We mapped Relay's tokens onto our brand in an afternoon. Focus states and the disabled palette were already accessible, which saved a full audit cycle.
relay.name: Nikhil J.

relay.title: Solid, docs could be deeper
relay.body: Components are well built. The usage notes for the data table are thin, so we wrote our own guidance for the team.
relay.name: Priya V.

relay.title: Renewed for a second year
relay.body: The licence terms were exactly as listed. Renewal was one email to the review desk.
relay.name: Sahil G.

paperplane.title: Fast launch page
paperplane.body: We shipped a waitlist page in two days. The hero variants are the strongest part; the pricing section needed rework for INR.
paperplane.name: Tanvi B.

paperplane.title: Good base, dated animations
paperplane.body: Layout and type are good. We removed most of the scroll effects because they slowed the page on older Android phones.
paperplane.name: Arjun K.

tessellate.title: Charts that look designed
tessellate.body: Every chart type came with light and dark variants and sensible defaults. The Figma file and the code matched, which is rare.
tessellate.name: Aditya L.

tessellate.title: Transfer was smooth
tessellate.body: Files arrived within the stated window. We had to replace one icon set that was licensed separately, as the exclusions said.
tessellate.name: Sneha P.

tessellate.title: Paid for itself
tessellate.body: We cancelled a charting library subscription after moving to Tessellate. Clean handover notes.
tessellate.name: Omkar W.

stackyard.title: Saved two months of admin work
stackyard.body: Role management and audit logs were production ready. The deployment scripts assumed an older Node version, which took a day to fix.
stackyard.name: Harsh V.

stackyard.title: Exactly what was described
stackyard.body: The condition ledger was accurate down to the failing test it mentioned. Handover call with the seller answered everything else.
stackyard.name: Kavya M.

tally-desk.title: GST invoices worked immediately
tally-desk.body: The invoice templates already handled GST breakdowns. We onboarded twelve freelancers in the first month on the licence.
tally-desk.name: Lakshmi N.

tally-desk.title: Reliable, small gaps
tally-desk.body: Bank reconciliation is basic. Everything else matched the record, including the export formats.
tally-desk.name: Deepak R.

mono-grid.title: The grid our editors wanted
mono-grid.body: Long reads finally look intentional. The baseline grid held up across Hindi and English body text, which we did not expect.
mono-grid.name: Ishita C.

mono-grid.title: Worth the yearly licence
mono-grid.body: Excellent print-style layouts. You will need your own image cropping rules; the kit does not include them.
mono-grid.name: Manav T.

ledger-docs.title: Search is the best feature
ledger-docs.body: Versioned docs with search out of the box. Setting up the API reference pages took longer than the record suggested.
ledger-docs.name: Rahul S.

ledger-docs.title: Moved our docs in a week
ledger-docs.body: The version switcher alone justified the licence. Support during the first thirty days was responsive.
ledger-docs.name: Neha A.

tabletop.title: Restaurants liked it
tabletop.body: Menu sync with Shopify worked for our pilot outlets. Provider approval for the app transfer took eleven days, as the record warned.
tabletop.name: Siddharth G.

tabletop.title: Needs a table-map update
tabletop.body: Ordering and payments are fine. The table layout editor is dated and struggled with larger floors.
tabletop.name: Pooja I.
